verdict.rationale: Sardine is a SaaS fraud and compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The llms.txt file and Sardine's internal agentic AML agents are adjacent features, not an MCP server that outside agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
